hook: Dow crashes 1,100 points as India CPI hits 6.1%, a two-year high

mood.basis: proxy: 0.35 x S&P 500 + 0.15 x avg(Nikkei, Kospi)

stories.title: Dow Jones tanks 1,100 points, nears technical correction as S&P 500 and Nasdaq fall over 2%
stories.summary: 460 stocks on the S&P 500 ended with losses on Thursday, showing how broad the selling was.
stories.why: A weak Wall Street often sets a cautious tone for Indian markets at the open.

stories.title: India's retail inflation hits a two-year high of 6.1%; Elara sees two quarter-point RBI hikes
stories.summary: Elara Securities expects above-6% inflation through March.
stories.why: Sticky inflation raises the odds of RBI rate hikes, which weigh on rate-sensitive stocks.

stories.title: Anthropic shares soar 21% in Nasdaq debut at a valuation near $1.8 trillion
stories.summary: It raised $81.3 billion in its IPO, a record for the largest-ever public offering.
stories.why: The AI trade is a key driver for global tech and for Indian IT services sentiment.

stories.title: Gold drops over 1% to a 14-month low of $3,588.20 an ounce on Fed hike worries
stories.summary: Gold is set for its worst week since March as the dollar strengthens ahead of a possible December Fed rate increase.
stories.why: Falling gold weighs on Indian gold lenders.

stories.title: Paytm, Pine Labs and MobiKwik tumble up to 9% on UPI MDR delay concerns
stories.summary: Reports say India may delay a planned fee on select high-value UPI payments.
stories.why: A delayed MDR hits the revenue outlook for payment companies.

movers.name: One 97 Communications
movers.why: Fell as much as 9% on the news

movers.name: Pine Labs
movers.why: Fell as much as 9% on the news

stories.title: Diamond Power bags ₹708 crore Adani Energy Solutions order for 9,059 km of conductors
stories.summary: The order for the ±800 kV Bhadla–Fatehpur HVDC project is due by December 31, 2027 and marks its entry into HVDC transmission.
stories.why: A large order with a firm delivery date lifts the company's revenue visibility.

stories.title: Banks hit a record 26% of Nifty 50 market value as Bank Nifty crosses 63,000
stories.summary: ICICI Bank leads the rally, while HDFC Bank recovers.
stories.why: Index concentration in banks makes the Nifty more sensitive to rate and credit news.

stories.title: Ashoka Buildcon loses ₹850 crore Saudi Arabia project as the client cancels it
stories.summary: Its order backlog falls from 16,000 crore to ₹15,100 crore after the cancellation.
stories.why: The cancellation trims the order book, though the backlog stays at 2.6 times trailing revenue.

stories.title: Urban Company raises ₹2,500 crore through QIP at ₹156 per share
stories.summary: It allotted 16.03 crore shares at a 3.12% discount to the floor price of ₹161.03.
stories.why: A large QIP strengthens the balance sheet but dilutes existing shareholders.

stories.title: Rupee hits a seven-month high as a 1% rise in the Nifty 50 lifts sentiment
stories.summary: Traders eye exporters for fresh fuel to extend the rupee's strength.
stories.why: A firmer rupee eases imported inflation and helps foreign flows.

stories.title: Record FPI buying returns as financial services account for half of November's inflows
stories.summary: Foreign investors are rebuilding positions in large-caps, but earnings and macro risks cloud the outlook.
stories.why: Foreign flows into banks and financials support the Nifty.

stories.title: Mutual funds bought ₹42,500 crore in October while FIIs sold ₹34,200 crore
stories.summary: The data is from Nuvama Alternative and Quantitative Research.
stories.why: Domestic funds are cushioning the market against foreign selling.

stories.title: Japan consumer prices rise 2.2% in October, strengthening the case for a BoJ rate hike
stories.summary: The Bank of Japan is seen raising rates in December.
stories.why: Higher Japanese rates can pull global liquidity away from emerging markets.

stories.title: SoftBank shares slump up to 16% as AI worries drown Asian chipmaker stocks
stories.summary: Japan's broader market fell on AI trade concerns and Wall Street losses.
stories.why: A global AI sell-off spills into tech-linked Indian stocks.

stories.title: AMD shares slide 8% as report says China links could invite US scrutiny
stories.summary: The report says AMD's firmware is used by a Chinese server maker and links it to blacklisted firms.
stories.why: Chip weakness feeds the global AI sell-off that Indian markets watch.

stories.title: IMF chief warns the AI sell-off may not be over, with circular financing near $1 trillion
stories.summary: Two-thirds of the circular financing is in debt, she said.
stories.why: Persistent AI worries keep global risk appetite fragile.

stories.title: Defence Ministry seeks 20% more capital spending for 2027–28; HAL and BEL seen gaining most
stories.summary: L&T, BEML, Bharat Dynamics, Mazagon Dock, Bharat Forge and Tata Advanced Systems may also gain.
stories.why: Higher defence capex points to more orders for listed defence makers.

stories.title: Manappuram Finance targets 25-30% AUM growth in FY27, plans 500 new branches by March
stories.summary: It has 5,375 branches today; Stage 3 assets in its gold loan book are at 1%.
stories.why: Gold lender expansion plans matter as gold prices swing.

stories.title: Voltas signs JV with Atomberg for room AC compressors, to acquire 50% stake
stories.summary: The venture will make AC compressors in India.
stories.why: Local compressor manufacturing could cut import dependence.

stories.title: Paytm to invest up to ₹200 crore in Funding Societies' units, takes 19.1% in CardUp
stories.summary: ₹162 crore buys the CardUp stake, with a five-year payments and lending technology partnership.
stories.why: Overseas expansion adds a new growth leg for Paytm.

stories.title: Dilip Buildcon bags ₹419 crore Gurugram Metro contract for depot and workshop
stories.summary: Execution is scheduled over 21 months.
stories.why: A fresh metro order adds to its order book.

stories.title: Sky Gold and Diamonds shareholders approve raising up to ₹1,800 crore through QIP and other routes
stories.summary: The board approved on October 27 and the EGM cleared it on November 18.
stories.why: Fundraising approval signals expansion plans but possible dilution.

stories.title: Signatureglobal adds 10.18 acres in Gurugram, eyes 0.86 million sq ft of development
stories.summary: The land is in Sohna, subject to licences and permissions.
stories.why: A bigger land bank supports its launch pipeline.

stories.title: Walmart raises its outlook for the year for the third time as e-commerce sales rise 23%
stories.summary: The retailer reported solid third-quarter sales.
stories.why: Strong US consumer data supports global retail and outsourcing demand.

stories.title: Palo Alto raises its sales forecast and buys AI startup Applied Compute for $4.5 billion
stories.summary: Its guidance lifted other cybersecurity stocks.
stories.why: Cybersecurity demand is a bright spot in global tech.

stories.title: Supreme Court dismisses Zuari Cement's plea against India Cements in a ₹26 crore dispute
stories.summary: The award directs payment of ₹26.40 crore plus interest.
stories.why: A legal overhang is cleared for India Cements.

stories.title: Over 70% of 2026 IPOs trade above issue price as companies leave more on the table
stories.summary: Elevated crude, rising bond yields and a stronger dollar have weighed on markets.
stories.why: Healthy listing gains support the IPO pipeline.

stories.title: GIFT Nifty open interest hits a record $22.21 billion, above October's $21.84 billion peak
stories.summary: There were 438,887 outstanding contracts on November 18.
stories.why: Offshore positioning in Nifty futures is at a record.

stories.title: Six listed REITs distribute ₹3,234 crore in Q2 to over 5.25 lakh unitholders
stories.summary: Gross assets under management exceeded ₹3.30 lakh crore.
stories.why: Strong office demand supports REIT payouts.

stories.title: Marquee investors' median portfolio gain falls to 4.4% in September quarter from 18.1% in June
stories.summary: Losses in Radhakishan Damani's holdings outweighed gains across most other portfolios.
stories.why: Cooling gains reflect a tougher market for stock pickers.
